{{Money|800}} (Group Bonus) |modifiers = [[Back to Basics (Modifier)|Back to Basics]] |rewards = {{Gem|125}}, {{Exp|400}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|3}} & 3 [[High Grade Crate]]s }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Players are given a loadout of basic towers.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Back to Basics''' is a [[Challenge Maps|challenge map]]. It uses a modified version of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Triumphing on this map rewards the player with {{Gem|125}}, {{Exp|400}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|3}} and three [[High Grade Crate]]s. Like with other challenges, rewards can only be obtained once a week. ==Changes== The main change in this challenge is all players start with a preset loadout, with the towers being the [[Scout]], [[Demoman]], [[Sniper]], [[Soldier]] and [[Hunter]]. These towers use default skins, unless you have the mentioned towers equipped. The golden perk cannot be applied. The wave structure is also altered, making it harder while multiple enemies are made weaker or stronger. There are also two other minor changes, first being the starting cash being increased and the second being towers giving a full refund when sold, though this does not work. ===Enemies=== This map uses the wave structure of legacy [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, with Wave 1 specifically being directly copied from modern [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Every enemy uses its modern variant if it exists. Some enemies are replaced with enemies from other modes. *[[Abnormal]] - 6 health ({{Color|No|-2}}) *[[Quick]] - 6 health ({{Color|No|-4}}) *[[Heavy]] - 16 health ({{Color|No|-44}}) *[[Abnormal Boss]] is replaced by the [[Normal Boss]] - 175 health ({{Color|Yes|+15}}) *[[Shadow]] is replaced by the [[Hidden]] - 20 health ({{Color|Yes|+10}}) *[[Breaker2]] - 50 health ({{Color|No|-30}}) *[[Dark Necromancer]] is replaced by the [[Fallen Necromancer]] - 500 health ({{Color|No|-700}}) *[[Skeleton]] - 35 health ({{Color|No|-25}}) **Uses its regular appearance. *[[Fallen]] - 180 health ({{Color|No|-45}}) *[[Giant Boss]] is replaced by the [[Fallen Giant]] - 2,000 health ({{Color|No|-2,000}}) *[[Shadow Boss]] is replaced by the [[Hidden Boss]] - 750 health ({{Color|Yes|+300}}) *[[Glitch]] is replaced by the [[Bolt]] - 240 health ({{Color|Yes|+175}}) *[[Hazard]] is replaced by the [[Hazmat]] - 250 health ({{Color|Yes|+100}}) *[[Tank]] is replaced by the [[Fallen Tank]] - 4,000 health ({{Color|No|-5,000}}) *[[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]] - 4,000 health ({{Color|No|-6,000}}) *[[Boomer]] - 2,000 health ({{Color|No|-1,000}}) *[[Summoner Boss]] is replaced by the [[Fallen Summoner]] - 6,000 health ({{Color|No|-9,000}}) **Summons [[Fallen]]s and [[Breaker4]]s. *[[Error]] is replaced by the [[Fallen Rusher]] - 300 health ({{Color|No|-100}}) **Shield health is unchanged. *[[Fallen Hero]] - 2,000 health ({{Color|No|-1,000}}) *[[Fallen Guardian]] - 6,000 health ({{Color|No|-26,000}}) *[[Fallen King]] - 60,000 health ({{Color|No|-140,000}}) A few enemies are also completely replaced: *[[Fallen Skeleton]] is replaced by the [[Skeleton]]. *[[Necrotic Skeleton]]s are replaced by the [[Breaker4]]. *[[Possessed Armor]] is replaced by the [[Fallen]]. Any enemies that do not have their health altered in any way by the challenge or modifiers present on this map are affected by [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode's health scaling. ===Wave Structure===
